name: rolefinder
description: Job search tool for company ATS boards. Pulls postings from Greenhouse and Ashby, scores them against a skill profile, and tracks applications.

scripts.build:live: npm run ingest && npm run build
scripts.check: node --check src/server.mjs && node --check src/ingest.mjs && node --check src/db.mjs && node --check src/sources.mjs && node --check src/score.mjs && node --check scripts/build-static.mjs && node --check scripts/serve-static.mjs && node --check public/app.js
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
